case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Human verification of citations and claims, accurate attribution and protection of confidential research information.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: N029 prohibits misrepresentation of source material, plagiarism, and misleading authorship while requiring confidentiality of research content, N115 (3.4.4) requires supervisor consultation and full AI acknowledgement in HDR theses, and N180 warns against uploading confidential research data to Gen-AI.
case_summary.case_note: Notre Dame's Code of Conduct: Research (N029) prohibits source misrepresentation, plagiarism, and confidentiality breaches, while N115 (3.4.4) requires HDR students to consult supervisors and acknowledge AI writing assistance. Although Library guidance against uploading confidential data to Gen-AI (N180) is non-binding for staff grant proposals, the framework provides structured discretion without a critical gap; Protocol v1.1 critical-risk criteria were adopted after preliminary review.
